description: Wasm size budget for the Harpocrates registry contract (#346). The budgets mirror the constants in contracts/contracts/harpocrates-registry/src/wasm_budget.rs; the gate in .github/workflows/contracts-ci.yml fails closed when the built artifact violates a budget or drifts more than regression_band_pct from the recorded baseline. Diagnostics carry sizes and digests only, never artifact bytes, proofs, witnesses, media, or keys.

baseline.note: Populated by 'python3 devx/wasm_size_budget.py --record' after the first build. The size budget applies even before a baseline exists; the digest is a best-effort audit trail for the deployed artifact.
